description: "The Rise of Iskander" by Earl of Beaconsfield Benjamin Disraeli is a novel written in 1832-1833. Based on the life of Albanian national hero Skanderbeg, it follows a young prince raised as a Muslim by his Turkish conquerors while secretly remaining Christian.
